# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## Application Window

- **Title Bar**: Displays "campaign_slides.pptx - LibreOffice Impress" indicating the current document and application.
- **System Tray / Top Bar**: Contains system icons including:
  - Activities button
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 17:01"
  - System status icons (network, sound, etc.)
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons on the top-right corner.

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help.
- **Active Menu**: The "Slide" menu is currently open, displaying its dropdown options.

## Toolbar

- **Icons**: A row of icons for common functions including:
  - New Slide
  - Duplicate Slide
  - Insert Slide from File
  - Layout
  - Delete Slide
  - Save Background Image
  - Set Background Image
  - Slide Properties
  - Change Slide Master
  - New Master
  - Delete Master
  - Master Background
  - Master Objects
  - Master Elements
  - Show Slide
  - Hide Slide
  - Rename Slide
  - Jump to Last Edited Slide
  - Move
  - Navigate
  - Summary Slide
  - Expand Slide
  - Slide Transition

## Slide Navigator Panel

- **Location**: Left side of the interface.
- **Content**: Displays thumbnails of all slides in the presentation.
- **Current Slide**: Slide 7 is highlighted with a blue border.
- **Slide Titles**: Slide 1 has a visible title: "Eradicating Heritable Disorders Through Prenatal Diagnostics".
- **Slide Count**: "Slide 7 of 7" is displayed at the bottom of the panel.

## Main Slide Editing Area

- **Current Slide**: Slide 7 is active and displayed in the main editing area.
- **Content**: A large yellow background with a large white arrow pointing diagonally upwards to the right.
- **Slide Elements**: The slide contains two buttons at the top:
  - "Get involved"
  - "Donate"
- **Slide Number**: "7" is displayed in the bottom-left corner of the slide.

## Properties Panel

- **Location**: Right side of the interface.
- **Panel Title**: "Properties"
- **Slide Properties**:
  - Format: "On-scr... w (16:9)"
  - Orientation: "Landscape"
  - Background: "None"
  - Master Slide: "BLANK_4"
  - Master Background: Checked
  - Master Objects: Checked
- **Layouts Section**:
  - Contains a grid of layout thumbnails.
  - The first layout thumbnail is selected and outlined in red.
  - Other layouts are displayed with different arrangements of text and content areas.

## Status Bar

- **Location**: Bottom of the interface.
- **Information**:
  - "Slide 7 of 7" indicating the current slide position.
  - "BLANK_4" indicating the current master slide.
  - Coordinates: "-0.39 / -1.40" and "0.00 x 0.00"
  - Language: "English (en)"
  - Zoom level: "123%"
